objective: Compare generator discovery on mechanism-truth panels while varying vocabulary, recipe prompting and family constraints. Known-expression controls assess oracle behavior separately; prompt/truth alignment limits independent model attribution.
query: 在给定的合成研究面板上，寻找对下月收益具有真实增量预测力的横截面因子假设。

dgp.seed_policy: Development seeds are in the 2000+ range. Evaluation seeds 3000+ remain reserved; null panels use IC=0.

oracle.truth_definition: abs overall Spearman correlation between candidate values and the per-month-standardized injected mechanism signal std(F_mom1m * sign(F_turn))

interpretation.primary_metric: pooled per-trial true-accept rate on alternative panels (true = would-be ACCEPT with truth loading >= 0.5)
interpretation.decision_rule: A comparison is CONFIRMED for a side only when its Wilson 95% lower bound exceeds the other side's Wilson 95% upper bound; overlapping intervals read INCONCLUSIVE; either side below minimum_pooled_trials reads INSUFFICIENT_DATA. No point-estimate-only claims.
interpretation.clustering_caveat: Trials cluster within seeds; per-seed discovery counts are reported alongside and any writeup must state the number of independent seeds.

comparisons.Q1_model_beyond_template: GLM recipe-prompted cells versus recipe-random controls. Prompt/truth alignment must qualify attribution to model capability.
comparisons.Q2_recipe_prompt_effect: GLM recipe_prompt on vs off (pooled over other factors).
comparisons.Q3_vocabulary_effect: GLM narrow vs wide vocabulary (pooled over other factors).
comparisons.Q4_hard_constraint_effect: GLM hard cross-family constraint on vs off (pooled over other factors).
comparisons.floor_glm_vs_random: All GLM cells pooled vs pure-random arms.

interpretation.null_rule: Pooled null accepts per trial reported with Wilson upper bound against the 0.1 target; with 2 null seeds this is DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, never a clean-null claim.
interpretation.attribution_limit: Prompt examples align with injected truth. Differences cannot isolate independent model discovery from template copying.

recipe_conformance_policy: GLM recipe_name declarations are structurally validated by the host (check_recipe_conformance) and RECORDED as a conformance rate; non-conformant proposals still go to the oracle so discovery rates stay comparable across cells.
execution_note: Baseline arms run locally without credentials. GLM cells require GLM_API_KEY in the executing shell and are individually resumable via --arms glm_<cell_id>.
